flags.what: ex1 'to race a dolphin' has tap target 'the boat', but no boat is visible in the still (filmed from the boat)
ex1 phrase / ex4 row 'to jump high into the sky': natives say 'into the air', but ex2 noun 2 must stay a visible thing ('the sky'), so left as is
ex1 'to lie on the grass' (target the apple): the apples are inside the bag, not on the grass; ex4 row repeats it
ex1 'to pick up an apple' (target the man): his visible hand holds a water bottle, nobody picks up an apple; ex4 row repeats it
ex3 caption 3 'I will select a cake.' is grammatical but stiff (natives would say 'pick'/'I'll'); kept because the key word and the chip 'will select' must stay
ex3 caption 2 'classical architecture': the room is baroque/rococo palace style, not strictly classical; acceptable in lay use, owner decides
